description_en: Creates a tunnel route in an existing VPC tunnel to specify the cloud resources in the VPC for Edge Security Acceleration (ESA) back-to-origin access. This is an asynchronous operation. The operation returns the init status. You can call GetTunnelRoute to query the status. A status of active indicates that the creation is complete
description_zh: 在已有VPC隧道中新增一条隧道路由，指定ESA回源访问的VPC内云资源。创建为异步操作，接口返回init状态，可调用GetTunnelRoute查询，Status为active表示创建完成
kebab_example: aliyun esa create-tunnel-route --vpc-tunnel-id 1234567890 --type ECS --biz-region cn-hangzhou --biz-endpoint i-bp1xxxxxxxx --api-version 2024-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTunnelRoute

parameters.help_en: The region where the cloud resource is located
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The cloud resource identifier. For ECS, ALB, NLB, CLB, and ENI, this is the instance ID, up to 128 characters in length. For OSS, this is the bucket name, up to 128 characters in length. For IpTarget, this is the destination IP address in the VPC, up to 64 characters in length. For VpcDomain, this is the domain name that can be parsed in the VPC. For RDS, this is the internal endpoint of ApsaraDB RDS, up to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 云资源标识。ECS、ALB、NLB、CLB、ENI为实例ID，最长128个字符；OSS为Bucket名称，最长128个字符；IpTarget为VPC内的目标IP，最长64个字符；VpcDomain为VPC内可解析的域名，RDS为RDS内网连接域名，最长256个字符
parameters.name: endpoint

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID. This parameter is required only when Type is set to IpTarget, VpcDomain, or RDS
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch IDs. For IpTarget, VpcDomain, and RDS, you must specify 1 to 8 vSwitch IDs, each 1 to 64 characters in length. For other types, you can only omit this parameter or pass an empty array
parameters.help_zh: VSwitch ID列表，IpTarget、VpcDomain、RDS必填1~8项，每项1~64字符；其它类型仅允许省略或空数组
parameters.name: vswitchids

parameters.help_en: The description. It can be up to 512 characters in length
parameters.name: description
